# Database

<!-- Generated by `php artisan docs:schema` from the live MySQL schema. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every household table has a ULID `id`, `household_id`, millisecond `created_at`/`updated_at`/`deleted_at` and a `synced_at` cursor for phone sync (left out of the module diagrams below to keep them readable). Design notes: [database-design.md](database-design.md).

## Households and accounts

```mermaid
erDiagram
    users {
        bigint id PK
        varchar name
        varchar email UK
        timestamp email_verified_at "nullable"
        varchar password
        text two_factor_secret "nullable"
        text two_factor_recovery_codes "nullable"
        timestamp two_factor_confirmed_at "nullable"
        varchar remember_token "nullable"
    }
    households {
        char id PK
        varchar name
        char currency
    }
    household_user {
        bigint id PK
        char household_id FK
        bigint user_id FK
        enum role
    }
    invites {
        char id PK
        char household_id FK
        bigint invited_by FK "nullable"
        varchar email
        enum role
        timestamp expires_at
        timestamp accepted_at "nullable"
    }
    devices {
        bigint id PK
        bigint user_id FK
        bigint personal_access_token_id FK "nullable"
        varchar expo_token UK
        enum platform "nullable"
        varchar name "nullable"
    }
    personal_access_tokens {
        bigint id PK
        varchar tokenable_type
        bigint tokenable_id
        text name
        varchar token UK
        text abilities "nullable"
        timestamp last_used_at "nullable"
        timestamp expires_at "nullable"
    }
    job_runs {
        bigint id PK
        char household_id FK
        varchar job
        enum status
        date for_date
        tinyint attempt
        json summary "nullable"
        text error "nullable"
        timestamp started_at
        timestamp finished_at "nullable"
        int duration_ms "nullable"
    }
    personal_access_tokens |o--o{ devices : "personal_access_token_id"
    users ||--o{ devices : "user_id"
    households ||--o{ household_user : "household_id"
    users ||--o{ household_user : "user_id"
    households ||--o{ invites : "household_id"
    users |o--o{ invites : "invited_by"
    households ||--o{ job_runs : "household_id"
```
